description: One FanDuel market next to the same market elsewhere: the Novig fair (no-vig) price, the DraftKings price and the PrizePicks line, with FanDuel's EV against the fair price and the better sportsbook price per side. Use it for "how does FanDuel's line on <player> compare?" or "is FanDuel's total off market?". Covers player props and game lines. Free plan: five minutes behind. A default call costs 3 credits (table: https://fanduelapi.com/credits).

league.description: League code, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, MLB, NCAAB, NCAAF, or a soccer league such as EPL, LALIGA, UCL, MLS.

offset.description: For the next page when has_more is true.

player.description: Player name or part of it.
